# jiku flow

Talk to the user in the language they write in, even when the skill you are running is written in
English; until they write something in their own words, use the product language. The messages a skill
quotes are templates, to be said in that language. What people of the product read — Jiku, the discovery, `README.md`, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md` —
goes in the product language (`language` in `_jflow/project.yaml`, Spanish when unset). Commits, MR/PR
text, branch names, test names, code, comments, identifiers and the documents for agents (`AGENTS.md`,
`CLAUDE.md`) go in English. See `.claude/specs/language.md`.
<!-- jiku flow: end -->
